correctness.rationale: Kernel evaluation gives exact Möbius circular sections. The factorizations (2+mu)(1-r²)A-Delta=(1-r²)²(1+mu+mu²r²) and 1-c=mu r²(1-r²)(1+mu r²)/Delta imply a<c<1 and rho/(1-c)=r/(1+mu r²)<1/(1+mu). A convex homothetic-disk inclusion bounds every section; the limiting circle and origin value prove equality of closed convex hulls. Compactness of radii rules out open tangent segments; tangent geometry proves the area; distance to the singleton and uniform symbol convergence establish a genuine jump. The parameter domain is exactly 0<mu<1. Finite checks were executed but not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The closed convex hull is a canonical geometry invariant of Berezin ranges. The theorem completely evaluates it, all tangent contact segments and its area on an entire natural analytic quadratic deformation. It proves a sharp macroscopic discontinuity (Hausdorff distance exactly 1, limiting positive area pi/4) under uniform perturbations of the symbol toward the identity. This is structural and not a lone arbitrary finite numerical value; it isolates a boundary-layer mechanism not shown by the previously known circle description.
